## ⚠️ Test data assumption

The SetVariable **projectId** must be the ID of a Google Cloud project the connected account can create buckets in (billing enabled, Cloud Storage JSON API enabled). The flows create their own buckets (`e2e-gcs-…`) in that project and delete them at the end. See artifacts/test-flows/README.md.
